input: Write a professional bio for my author website

gold.taskTitle: Write a Professional Bio for Your Author Website
gold.taskDescription: Create a polished, professional author biography to be published on the user's author website.

questions.title: What genre or type of writing do you focus on?
questions.description: Understanding the genre (fiction, non-fiction, poetry, thriller, etc.) shapes the tone and content of the bio.

questions.title: Have you published any books, articles, or other works?
questions.description: Knowing existing publications helps highlight credentials and establishes credibility in the bio.

questions.title: What tone should the bio have: formal, conversational, or literary?
questions.description: The desired tone determines word choice and style throughout the bio.

questions.title: How long should the bio be, roughly?
questions.description: Author bios can range from a single punchy paragraph to several detailed paragraphs; knowing the target length guides structure.

questions.title: What professional background or credentials should be included?
questions.description: Relevant education, awards, memberships, or career history that strengthen your authority as a writer.

questions.title: Should the bio be written in first person or third person?
questions.description: Author websites commonly use third person, but some writers prefer the intimacy of first person.

questions.title: What personal details, if any, do you want included?
questions.description: Some authors add a human touch with details like location, hobbies, family, or pets to connect with readers.
